title: Mafatih al-Ghayb
author: fakhr-al-din-al-razi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Fakhr al-Din al-Razi's extensive commentary on the Qur'an, moving through the text with grammar, rhetoric, theology, philosophy and the natural sciences. It is one of the fullest medieval tafsirs and a central witness to the encounter between kalam and Avicennian philosophy.
historicalContext: Composed in the late twelfth and early thirteenth centuries, partly in Herat and partly in Rayy. Its rational theology and philosophical vocabulary made it a standard reference and a target for later critics.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
